nearme-info-heading: Heading shown before the user searches.
nearme-info-description: Description shown before the user searches.
nearme-show-button: Label for the button that requests geolocation and loads nearby results.
nearme-show-button-table:
Label when a specific Cargo source is selected. Parameters:
* $1 - display label for the table
nearme-filter-all: Label for the table picker option that searches all configured Cargo tables.
nearme-filter-label: Accessible label for the table picker tablist.
nearme-privacy-hint: Short privacy note shown before the first search.
nearme-try-without-gps: Label before example location link(s) in the hero area.
nearme-map-label: Accessible label for the results map region.
nearme-map-you-are-here: Popup label on the map marker for the search origin.
nearme-distance-km:
Distance label in kilometres. Parameters:
* $1 - formatted distance
nearme-distance-m:
Distance label in metres. Parameters:
* $1 - formatted distance
nearme-requirements: Title of the noscript error box.
nearme-requirements-guidance: Body of the noscript error box.
nearme-error-guidance: Guidance shown after a generic error.
nearme-noresults: Message when the search returns zero results.
nearme-noresults-guidance: Guidance when the search returns zero results.
nearme-permission-denied: Error when the user denies location permission.
nearme-locating: Loading indicator while waiting for browser geolocation.
nearme-loading: Loading indicator while searching Cargo for nearby pages.
nearme-error-cargo-missing: Error when Cargo is not installed.
nearme-error-unknown-table:
Error for an unknown Cargo table. Parameters:
* $1 - table name
nearme-error-no-sources: Error when no valid Cargo tables are configured in MediaWiki:NearMe-config or $wgNearMeTables.
